text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Let's review course details! Starting point is Bubbly Land, 
with all 4 legs tied together in relay format, 
heading for the finish line at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Leg 1 is swimming! Racers swim across pool 
with splashing, crashing waves! Adapting to 
water conditions will be key to victory!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Leg 2 is mission run! Runners cannot hand off 
baton to next section until mission is completed!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Mission was just announced earlier! It is: “Add unique custom 
twist to unmixed sports drink base”!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Leg 3 is cycling! Course features intense hills, 
and when crossing mountain path, 
it splits into 3 distinct routes!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Short but steep mountain climb route, 
long detour riverbed route looping mountain, 
and middle hill route between them!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Branching routes merge back together mid-downhill 
slope! Route selection will definitely be decisive factor!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Final anchor leg, Leg 4, is running! 
One full lap around Tracen Academy's main turf track!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Winning team receives commemorative shield and grand prize 
from sponsor! Special prize will also go to team that puts on 
most entertaining show!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, get ready for fiery battle among 
Tracen Academy students! Team Triathlon 
tournament is officially underway!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho, if it ain't team 'This and That' over there.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Team name sounds pretty sick! Has that raw, 
dystopian vibe where heavy demons assemble!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I desired grander title, but character 
limit proved far too restrictive to register!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Teammates claimed majesty of supreme title was too overwhelming, 
so after noble council, we settled upon this current moniker!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: U-Um... looks like race is starting any second, desu!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oi Spe, quit spacing out! You get importance of team name?! 
Needs that spice, that punch! See, naming is everything—
*BANG!*

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Starting gun echoes! Racers dive in all at 
once... Wait, Gold Ship completely botched start...!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Yet Gold Ship maintains deadpan expression! 
Is she unbothered by massive delay?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yahooo~! Told ya, strap board on and you're riding 
waves! Behold! Golshi-chan's god-tier balance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Utopia of ancient myth— Let Overlord 
bring radiant brilliance to this fleeting paradise 
of sparkling foam and mist!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, revel in spectacle! Frolic with 
Babbly fairies alongside water-drenched Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! TM Opera O and Gold Ship strike dramatic 
poses atop surfboards for some bizarre reason!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! Surfing looks so fun, I want to try it too!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Rules allow limited sponsor equipment usage, 
so surfboards are legal, however...

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Pair on boards haven't moved forward at 
all! They're just bobbing up and down in waves!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Good grief... such raw simplicity. Unmoving composure is true beauty.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guess this makes it duel between you and me! 
Special prize is mine, pal!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: M-Maybe I should put on performance too...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah~! Spe-chan, just swim normally, eii-eii-mun!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Chaotic swim leg reaches climax! Leaders are 
about to hand off to 2nd runners!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O and Gold Ship, far behind pack, 
charge forward in furious final burst! Still refusing to drop boards!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week takes the lead! She's 
sprinting toward 2nd runner Matikane Tannhauser!
